project.name: Haldora launch: brand, site, portal, app and product experience

deliverables.title: Brand identity: logo system, icons, applications, guidelines
Design tokens for web, native and 3D
Marketing website: source and production build
Web application: source and production build
3D experience: source, model and production build
Mobile application: source and native JS bundles

approvals.title: Creative direction chosen by the client
Experience DNA and design system approved

manualAuditsOutstanding: Screen-reader walkthrough (VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack): automated rules cover only part of WCAG 2.2.
Testing on real phones and a low-powered laptop: frame timing here comes from one desktop GPU.
Field Core Web Vitals (75th percentile of real visits): only available after launch.
Native iOS and Android builds, device gestures and store review.
Copy review by a fluent Arabic editor and a legal review of claims.
